cds.title: James Madison University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (Word)

cost.notes: College Scorecard (data released 2026-10-15; IPEDS charges for 2025-26, which match the 2025-26 cost tables published by Berea, Pitzer and Scripps): tuition includes required fees; on-campus cost of attendance. The Common Data Set 2025-26 ticks '2026-2027 costs of attendance are not available' and leaves G1 and G5 blank, so the College Scorecard figures are kept.

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set 2025-26 (fall 2025 first-year class): 42,595 applied, 29,300 admitted, 4,935 enrolled; the in-state, out-of-state and international rows add up to those totals. International (nonresident) first-years: 149 applied, 131 admitted, 11 enrolled. Waitlist: 2,973 offered a place, 704 later admitted; the number who accepted a place is 'NA'. No early decision; non-binding early action. The CDS leaves the high school GPA table blank and writes 'NA' for average GPA, so no GPA figures are shown. SAT submitted by 16% (776 students) and ACT by 3% (122), so the SAT and ACT percentiles describe only those who sent scores; the CDS gives ACT section scores as blank. Undergraduate enrollment (21,358) is the 'total all undergraduates' count (20,129 full-time, 1,229 part-time); the 137 nonresident count is the degree-seeking undergraduate row (the nonresident cell in the total-undergraduate column, 14, covers non-degree-seeking students only). CDS C8F: 'JMU is test optional.'
